title: Cross-model source-grounded AI proposal qualification
goal: Require independent source-grounded qualification before any AI proposal can become Refine feedback.
laws: Raw ADVISORY proposals are not selectable.
Reviewer node/model must differ from proposer node/model.
Every reviewer claim cites an exact substring from the supplied source bundle.
Any claimed absent token is checked deterministically.
Only SUPPORTED suggestion indexes become eligible.
Qualification and selection grant no mutation, acceptance, or release authority.
live_council: T590/llama3.2 proposer -> Legion/qwen3:8b fact-checker -> deterministic evidence verifier.
